newsitem.title: CANADA: Ridgeway names J. Bruce Petrie CFO.
newsitem.headline: Ridgeway names J. Bruce Petrie CFO.

text.p: Ridgeway Petroleum Corp said Tuesday it named J. Bruce Petrie Chief Financial Officer of the company.
The company said Petrie is a chartered accountant with 24 years experience in the petroleum industry, more recently as vice-president and controller of a major international oil and gas company.

The company also said it recently increased the delineation and development activities related to its Arizona C0(2) Project'' following the successful closing of two fundings earlier in 1997 which provided gross proceeds of $20 million.
